license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in this State, or offer or attempt to do so, unless such person is the holder of a valid license or certificate of renewal of license duly issued by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners.

issuing_authority.value: North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners heretofore created by Chapter 139, Public Laws 1879 and by Chapter 178, Public Laws 1915, is hereby continued as the agency of the State for the regulation of the practice of dentistry in this State.

name.value: North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners
name.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners heretofore created by Chapter 139, Public Laws 1879 and by Chapter 178, Public Laws 1915, is hereby continued as the agency of the State for the regulation of the practice of dentistry in this State.

type.quote: Said Board of Dental Examiners shall consist of six dentists who are licensed to practice dentistry in North Carolina, one dental hygienist who is licensed to practice dental hygiene in North Carolina and one person who shall be a citizen and resident of North Carolina and who shall be licensed to practice neither dentistry nor dental hygiene.

age_minimum.quote: The applicant for a license to practice dentistry shall be of good moral character, at least 18 years of age at the time the application is filed.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant for a license to practice dentistry shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: graduate of a reputable dental college or the dental department of a reputable university or college recognized, accredited and approved as such by the Board
degree_required.quote: the applicant is a graduate of and has a diploma from a reputable dental college or the dental department of a reputable university or college recognized, accredited and approved as such by the Board

accrediting_body.quote: shall have graduated from and have a DDS or DMD degree from a program of dentistry in a school or college accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association and approved by the Board

required.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners shall grant licenses to practice dentistry to such applicants who are graduates of a reputable dental institution, who, in the opinion of a majority of the Board, shall undergo a satisfactory examination of proficiency in the knowledge and practice of dentistry

exams.notes: Board may conduct its own or accept results of Board-approved regional or national independent third-party clinical examinations including procedures on human subjects.
exams.quote: the applicant has passed a clinical licensing examination, the standard of which shall be determined by the Board

exams.notes: Required for licensure by credentials applicants.
exams.quote: successfully complete examinations in Jurisprudence and Sterilization and Infection Control

exams.quote: successfully complete examinations in Jurisprudence and Sterilization and Infection Control

interval_years.quote: all licenses heretofore issued by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners or hereafter issued by said Board are subject to annual renewal

required.quote: All dentists licensed under G.S. 90-30 shall be required to attend Board-approved courses of study in subjects relating to dentistry.

available.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners may issue a license by credentials to an applicant who has been licensed to practice dentistry in any state or territory of the United States if the applicant produces satisfactory evidence to the Board that the applicant has the required education, training, and qualifications

requirements.value: Applicant must have DDS or DMD from CODA-accredited program, good moral character, five years of active practice, no disciplinary action, no failed NC Board examination, and must pass Jurisprudence and Sterilization and Infection Control examinations. Border-state applicants (bordering NC) receive mandatory licensure by credentials under a reciprocal arrangement.
requirements.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners shall issue a license by credentials to any dentist who applies for a license by credentials and who holds a current license and is in good standing with the licensing jurisdiction in one of the four states that border North Carolina provided that the dental board of the border state will also issue a license by credentials to a dentist having a license to practice in North Carolina.

exists.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners heretofore created by Chapter 139, Public Laws 1879 and by Chapter 178, Public Laws 1915, is hereby continued as the agency of the State for the regulation of the practice of dentistry in this State.

national_association.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association and approved by the Board

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in this State, or offer or attempt to do so, unless such person is the holder of a valid license or certificate of renewal of license duly issued by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners.

title_protection.quote: Uses, in connection with his name, any title or designation, such as "dentist," "dental surgeon," "doctor of dental surgery," "D.D.S.," "D.M.D.," or any other letters, words or descriptive matter which, in any manner, represents him as being a dentist able or qualified to do or perform any one or more of the acts or practices set forth in subdivisions (1) through (10) above

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in this State, or offer or attempt to do so, unless such person is the holder of a valid license or certificate of renewal of license duly issued by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent use of intoxicants, drugs, or narcotics impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of criminal provisions of the Dental Practice Act or plea of guilty/nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to any felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any felony charge or to any misdemeanor charge involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge of violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any act or practice violating this Article or Board rules, or aided/abetted others in violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board, or has aided, abetted or assisted any other person or entity in the violation of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mentally, emotionally, or physically unfit to practice or having a disability dangerous to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is mentally, emotionally, or physically unfit to practice dentistry or is afflicted with such a physical or mental disability as to be deemed dangerous to the health and welfare of his patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: In-person solicitation of professional patronage or employing others to conduct such solicitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has conducted in-person solicitation of professional patronage or has employed or procured any person to conduct such solicitation by personal contact with potential patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting use of name, diploma, or license by another for illegal practice or to fraudulently obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted the use of his name, diploma or license by another person either in the illegal practice of dentistry or in attempting to fraudulently obtain a license to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct discrediting the dental profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the dental profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or aiding an unlicensed person to perform acts that can only lawfully be done by a licensed dentist or hygienist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed a person not licensed in this State to do or perform any act or service, or has aided, abetted or assisted any such unlicensed person to do or perform any act or service which under this Article or under Article 16 of this Chapter, can lawfully be done or performed only by a dentist or a dental hygienist licensed in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incompetent in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation upon the public or individuals to acquire or retain patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon the public or upon any individual in an effort to acquire or retain any patient or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading statements about skill, knowledge, or method of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to his skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed any fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing untruthful, fraudulent, or misleading advertisements inconsistent with Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has, directly or indirectly, published or caused to be published or disseminated any advertisement for professional patronage or business which is untruthful, fraudulent, misleading, or in any way inconsistent with rules and regulations issued by the Board of Dental Examiners governing the time, place, or manner of such advertisements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of malpractice in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has, in the practice of dentistry, committed an act or acts constituting malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a dental hygienist or assistant to violate the Dental Practice Act or Dental Hygiene Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted a dental hygienist or a dental assistant in his employ or under his supervision to do or perform any act or acts violative of this Article, or of Article 16 of this Chapter, or of the rules and regulations promulgated by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully or fraudulently holding out as a specialist in any branch of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has wrongfully or fraudulently or falsely held himself out to be or represented himself to be qualified as a specialist in any branch of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistently maintaining unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has persistently maintained, in the practice of dentistry, unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques

disciplinary_grounds.description: Constituting a menace to public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a menace to the public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distributing intoxicants, drugs, or narcotics for other than a lawful purpose
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has distributed or caused to be distributed any intoxicant, drug or narcotic for any other than a lawful purpose

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined by Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unprofessional conduct as the same may be, from time to time, defined by the rules and regulations of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing fee-splitting for the use of teledentistry services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has allowed fee-splitting for the use of teledentistry services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Limiting a patient's right or ability to raise grievances or file complaints with oversight bodies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has limited, in any way, a patient's right or ability to raise grievances or file complaints with any appropriate oversight body, including the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners

definition_quote.value: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry in this State who does, undertakes or attempts to do, or claims the ability to do any one or more of the following acts or things which, for the purposes of this Article, constitute the practice of dentistry: (1) Diagnoses, treats, operates, or prescribes for any disease, disorder, pain, deformity, injury, deficiency, defect, or other physical condition of the human teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, maxilla, mandible, or adjacent tissues or structures of the oral cavity; (2) Removes stains, accretions or deposits from the human teeth; (3) Extracts a human tooth or teeth; (4) Performs any phase of any operation relative or incident to the replacement or restoration of all or a part of a human tooth or teeth with any artificial substance, material or device; (5) Corrects the malposition or malformation of the human teeth; (6) Administers an anesthetic of any kind in the treatment of dental or oral diseases or physical conditions...
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry in this State who does, undertakes or attempts to do, or claims the ability to do any one or more of the following acts or things which, for the purposes of this Article, constitute the practice of dentistry

value: diagnosis and treatment of oral diseases, disorders, and conditions
removal of stains and deposits from teeth
extraction of teeth
replacement or restoration of teeth with artificial substances
correction of malposition or malformation of teeth
administration of anesthetics in dental treatment
taking impressions of teeth, gums, or jaws
making, constructing, or placing prosthetic dentures, bridges, and appliances
use of X-ray/Roentgen machines for dental treatment or diagnostic purposes
clinical practices included in curricula of recognized dental schools
ownership or management of dental enterprises
administration of COVID-19 diagnostic and antibody tests (FDA-approved/EUA)
methods_authorized.quote: Diagnoses, treats, operates, or prescribes for any disease, disorder, pain, deformity, injury, deficiency, defect, or other physical condition of the human teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, maxilla, mandible, or adjacent tissues or structures of the oral cavity

drug_authority.value: Licensed dentists may prescribe, and legally licensed druggists may fill prescriptions of dentists duly licensed by the NC Board. Dentists may administer anesthetics of any kind in dental treatment. Teledentistry prescriptions for analgesics or pain medication must comply with NC Controlled Substance Reporting System requirements.
drug_authority.quote: Legally licensed druggists of this State may fill prescriptions of dentists duly licensed by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners.

value: general anesthesia
enteral sedation
parenteral sedation
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: Regulatory standards may include a permit process for general anesthesia and enteral and parenteral sedation by dentists.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: his or her office facilities pass an on-site examination and inspection by qualified representatives of the Board

value: direct supervision (supervising dentist physically present)
supervision (dentist physically present during performance of acts)
direction without direct supervision (under written standing order, dentist not physically present, for qualified hygienists in specified settings)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" as used in this Article shall mean that acts are deemed to be under required supervision only when performed in a locale where the supervising licensed dentist is physically present

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist in private practice may not employ more than two dental hygienists at one and the same time who are employed in clinical dental hygiene positions.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist who has three years of experience in clinical dental hygiene or a minimum of 2,000 hours performing primarily prophylaxis or periodontal debridement under the supervision of a licensed dentist... may perform one or more dental hygiene functions as described in G.S. 90-221(a) under the direction of a dentist based on a written standing order, rather than an in-person evaluation by the dentist and without a licensed dentist being physically present

value: nursing home residents
rest home residents
long-term care facility residents
school populations
patients at rural and community clinics operated by Board-approved nonprofits
patients at rural and community clinics operated by federal, State, county, or local governments
patients at federally qualified health centers
patients at facilities identified by the Office of Rural Health and approved by the Board as serving dental access shortage areas
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: The services are performed in nursing homes; rest homes; long-term care facilities; schools; rural and community clinics operated by Board-approved nonprofits; rural and community clinics operated by federal, State, county, or local governments; federally qualified health centers; and any other facilities identified by the Office of Rural Health and approved by the Board as serving dental access shortage areas.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A licensed dentist who prescribes any type of analgesic or pain medication as part of the provision of teledentistry services shall comply with all applicable North Carolina Controlled Substance Reporting System requirements.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any licensed dentist who employs or engages the services of any person, firm or corporation to construct or repair, extraorally, prosthetic dentures, bridges, orthodontic appliance, or other replacements, for a part of a tooth, a tooth or teeth, shall furnish such person, firm or corporation with a written work order on forms prescribed by the North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Practice of Teledentistry Requirements. - For the purposes of this Article, the practice of teledentistry includes any of the following: (1) Delivery of service. - Teledentistry services may be delivered by a licensed dentist or a licensed dental hygienist who is under the supervision of a licensed dentist.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: dental hygiene shall include the administration of local anesthetics by infiltration and block techniques by dental hygienists certified pursuant to G.S. 90-225.2
